purpose: Laut logo proposals; visual drafts for selection, not installed app icons.

concepts.name: 01-klang-l
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished logo proposal presentation for "Laut", a native macOS app for local, private audio transcription, speaker editing and dictation. Audience international, intelligent and approachable productivity tool. Fresh original design. Palette informed by existing app: deep teal/petrol, dark ink and warm off-white. Flat, crisp vector-like forms, strong silhouette, optically balanced, legible at tiny app-icon sizes. No microphones, padlocks, AI sparkles, headphones, clouds, generic futuristic effects, gradients, 3D or stock mockup scenery. Landscape composition, generous whitespace. Main symbol and the exact wordmark "Laut" centered as a large horizontal lockup, beautifully spaced contemporary humanist sans typography, title case L-a-u-t. Along the bottom show a smaller monochrome version and a small rounded-square macOS app-icon application of the SAME mark. No other text, labels or slogans. Main background warm off-white. This image is a reviewable brand proposal, not a screenshot. Concept: a memorable custom capital L built from three broad upright rounded sound bars; the left bar is tallest and continues into a short rightward foot, so the complete silhouette reads as one confident L with a rising/falling audio rhythm in its interior. Keep extremely simple, bold, purposeful and distinctive, generous negative space. The custom mark should visually connect sound to the initial letter without appearing as a stock equalizer.
